# Broad Peak Adventures

> Broad Peak Adventures is a premier, 100% locally-owned mountaineering agency and tour operator based in Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. We specialize in high-altitude Karakoram expeditions, K2 Base Camp trekking, cultural tours, and custom private travel.

## Key Pages & Documentation

- [Home](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/): Overview of Broad Peak Adventures, featured expeditions, and safety standards.
- [Expeditions](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expeditions): Full catalog of high-altitude treks, peak climbing expeditions, and cultural tours.
- [K2 Base Camp Trek](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=k2): 21-day extreme Karakoram trek to Concordia and K2 Base Camp.
- [Travel Guides](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/travel-guides): Expert advice, logistics, gear lists, and visa guidance for Northern Pakistan.
- [Blog & Articles](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/blog): Trekking journals, expedition stories, and seasonal travel advice.
- [About Us](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/about): Company history, local guide expertise, sustainability principles, and safety protocols.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/contact): Custom trip planning form and instant WhatsApp booking options.
- [FAQ](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/faq): Answers regarding visas, NOC permits, fitness requirements, and payment policies.

## Core Expeditions

- [K2 Base Camp Trek](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=k2): 21 Days | 5,585m Max Alt | Extreme | $2,850
- [Attabad Lake & Hunza Explorer](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=attabad-lake): 7 Days | 2,500m Max Alt | Moderate | $1,200
- [Fairy Meadows & Nanga Parbat](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=fairy-meadows): 8 Days | 3,300m Max Alt | Moderate-Hard | $1,150
- [Deosai Plains & Skardu](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=deosai-sunrise): 6 Days | 4,114m Max Alt | Easy-Moderate | $980
